name: How long does bathroom trim installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom trim installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing new trim in a standard bathroom usually takes one to two days. The timeline depends heavily on the scope of the project, including whether existing baseboards or casing must be removed, the condition of the drywall underneath, and if caulking and painting are included. For projects involving custom door casings, window trim, and baseboards along uneven tile floors, Abraham Becerra and the HH Remodeling crew measure, scribe, cut, nail, fill fastener holes, and apply moisture-resistant caulk and paint. If drywall repairs or extensive tile touch-ups are uncovered after removing old molding, that prep work can add extra time before finish carpentry begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom trim installation typically takes one to two days, depending on room size, drywall prep, and whether caulking and painting are part of the scope.
